subject: GCP private offer: billing cadence & drawdown schedule for Acme AI
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.gcp@gcp-partner.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acme-ai.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Private Offer: Redwood Inference - commitment & drawdown options for Acme AI

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. Following up with the private offer packet for Acme AI attached (RDW_Acme_PrivateOffer_TermSheet_v1.pdf). High level: GCP can process a private offer that maps a committed USD amount to Marketplace credits. You can choose between two drawdown modes we typically support:

- Monthly equal drawdown (default): committed USD is converted to monthly Marketplace credits that draw as usage occurs. Unused credits can rollover for the contract term but expire at term end.
- Usage-first drawdown: credits are consumed as invoiced usage is reported; monthly billing reconciliation occurs with any short/over usage billed at the end of the month.

For Acme (expected ~$120k/quarter), I flagged the deal for co-sell and we can include an initial 10% onboarding credit if you commit to a 12-month term. Questions we need answered to finalize: billing contact for procurement, preferred drawdown mode, and whether Acme needs commit broken out by project (they mentioned two GCP projects for prod/dev).

Next steps: if you confirm preferred drawdown mode and billing contact by COB Wed (11/12), I can submit the private offer to legal and provide a DocuSign link within 48 hours.

Attachments: RDW_Acme_PrivateOffer_TermSheet_v1.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Sara
Sr. Partner Sales, Google Cloud Marketplace

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.gcp@gcp-partner.com>
Cc: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acme-ai.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private Offer: Redwood Inference - commitment & drawdown options for Acme AI

Sara — thanks for the term sheet and the fast turnaround. We're keen to move forward; Acme signaled preference for monthly equal drawdown because they want predictable monthly credits tied to individual GCP projects. A few clarifying questions before we ask Acme to sign: 

1) Minimum monthly drawdown: can GCP support an initial ramp (50% month 1, then full) for the first 3 months as Acme migrates traffic?
2) Rollover rules: confirm unused monthly credits roll month-to-month within the 12-month term but cannot carry past term end.
3) Project tagging: need a short note on how Marketplace credits are mapped to project ids and whether we can split commit across two projects.
4) Billing contact: procure@acme.com (procurement team). Jordan is PM for the contract and will get looped for approvals.

Attaching a quick proposed pricing adjustment we want GCP to consider (proposed_pricing_adjustments.xlsx). Can you also provide the itemized pricing table showing token tiers vs. Marketplace pricing? That will help Acme's procurement team.

If we can get a DocuSign link with the above clarified (especially ramp and project split), I'll route to Acme procurement this week.

Thanks — cc'ing Dylan and Laura for negotiation + legal follow-up.

—Vanessa
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Private Offer: Redwood Inference - commitment & drawdown options for Acme AI

Team — forwarding Sara's term sheet and my reply. Quick plan: 

- Ask GCP to accept a 3-month ramp (50% / 75% / 100%) on monthly drawdown; this reduces initial cost exposure for Acme while keeping the commit intact.
- Require explicit confirmation in the DocuSign text that unused credits roll month-to-month and expire at contract end (no auto-renew).
- Request credits to be splittable across projects by project id and that GCP provides a monthly usage report broken down by project.
- Negotiate the 10% onboarding credit be applied in month 1 as a line-item credit (not a separate rebate).
- If GCP pushes back on ramp, ask for a one-time onboarding credit increase to 15% or an initial $10k consumption credit.

Action items:
- Dylan: please draft a 1-page negotiation note for Sara/legal that summarizes the ramp and reporting requirements (deadline: EOD Thu 11/13).
- Laura: run quick check with legal on language we need for "rollover" and "project mapping" (deadline: EOD Thu 11/13).

Attachment: proposed_pricing_adjustments.xlsx (xlsx)

Vanessa

From: Sara Lim <sara.gcp@gcp-partner.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@acme-ai.com>
Cc: procure@acme.com
Date: Fri, 14 Nov 2025 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Private Offer: Redwood Inference - commitment & drawdown options for Acme AI

Vanessa / Jordan — thanks for the specifics and the proposed adjustment file. Per internal check with legal & billing: 

- GCP is comfortable with a 3-month ramp (50% / 75% / 100%) applied to the monthly equal drawdown. We'll include that schedule in the private offer terms.
- Rollover: confirmed — unused monthly credits will roll within the 12-month term and expire at term end. We'll add explicit language in Section 4.2 of the offer.
- Project split: Marketplace credits can be associated with multiple projects. We'll require the projects be declared at activation; however, credits are centrally pooled and GCP will provide a monthly usage report broken out by project id per your request.
- Onboarding credit: we can increase the onboarding credit to 12% (one-time line-item in month 1) as a compromise.

I've updated the private offer and generated a DocuSign package: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/abc123-private-offer. The DocuSign includes the ramp schedule, rollover clause, and project reporting. Please review and let me know if anything else needs to be added before we send to Procure.

Attachment: [DocuSign link provided above]

Next steps: Vanessa to confirm and route to Procure (procure@acme.com) for signature. After signature, billing will map committed credits to Acme's Marketplace account (we'll coordinate activation).

Thanks,
Sara
Sr. Partner Sales, Google Cloud Marketplace
